title: Glass Specification Software | IGU, Edges, Lead & Georgian | Coglass
description: Specify any glass in full — DGU/TGU make-ups, every edge and shape, and a drawing canvas for holes, Georgian bars, lead and diamond. Then print a 1:1 template. Built for glass, not a product dropdown.
lead: Generic job software makes you cram a window into a “product” box. Coglass doesn't — full IGU make-ups, every edge and shape, and a drawing canvas where you place holes, Georgian bars, lead and diamond, then print a 1:1 template the factory lays the glass straight onto.
steps_h2: From window on site to glass on the bench
steps_sub: Coglass holds the full make-up of every pane, so the right glass gets cut, sealed and fitted — first time.
inc_h2: Glass detail no generic CRM can hold
inc_sub: Every option a real glass order needs — because Coglass was built for glass.
steps: Pick single glazed, DGU or TGU and Coglass captures the full build — the glass type for each leaf, cavity, spacer and gas.
Width × height in mm, quantity, and any shape — rectangle, arch, circle, oval, gable, trapezoid. Stored to the millimetre — no unit conversion, no product-dropdown guesswork.
Add edge-finishing and glass-processing operations to any pane — each priced as its own operation alongside the glass.
Draw the features on the pane
Open the drawing canvas and place holes, cut-outs, Georgian bars, lead and diamond lattices right on the glass — sized off the edges in mm.
Coglass prices the glass per m² or per unit from your catalogue, plus every operation — with trade price-lists and quantity breaks applied.
Send the lead, Georgian and diamond patterns to a full-size tiled A4 “lay-under” template — the factory lays the glass straight onto it and copies the pattern.
included: Full IGU make-ups
DGU and TGU units with the glass type for each leaf, cavity width, spacer bar and gas fill — captured per line, not crammed into one product.
Cavity is line-level
Set 12/16/20mm per order line (and a second cavity for triple units) — no exploding your catalogue with a variant of every unit.
Edge finishing
Add edge-finishing operations to a pane and price each one individually.
Every shape
Rectangle, arch, circle, oval, gable, trapezoid, semicircle, triangle and more.
Georgian bars
Bar positions, columns, rows, width and colour — priced per metre of bar and drawn on the pane.
Lead & diamond
Square, rectangular and diamond lead lattices with cell size and lead width — drawn and priced.
Holes & cut-outs
Drilled holes (priced per diameter tier), rectangular cut-outs, letterboxes and corner notches — placed in mm.
In-house or bought-in operations
Mark any operation as made in-house or bought in from a processor — Coglass raises the outwork order.
Save as a product
Build a unit once, save it to your catalogue, and the survey matcher re-uses it automatically next time.
1:1 lay-under template
Lead, Georgian and diamond patterns print full-size across A4 with crop marks — the factory copies straight onto the glass.
Trade price-lists
Per-customer and per-type price lists with quantity breaks and contract windows, applied automatically.
RAL paint codes
Record the RAL colour for painted glass and frames against the line.
cta_h2: Spec glass the way it’s actually made
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
